lines.en: I fly along the cavern roof.

lines.zh: 我落在地上，走两步又起跳。
lines.en: I land, walk two steps, and lift off again.
I hop along with my wings folded.

lines.zh: 我从一块岩跳到另一块。
lines.en: I spring from one rock to another.
I circle you, wings half open.

lines.zh: 我抬头，找能落脚的地方。
lines.en: I look up for somewhere to perch.
One jump carries me a good way.
I keep to the cliff face, steady.
I stop and shake out my wings.
I fly toward the light from the roof.
I take a wide turn in the air.
I glide from low ground to high.

lines.zh: 我一步一步走，翅膀收着。
lines.en: I walk step by step, wings folded.

lines.zh: 我又跳了一下，落到你旁边。
lines.en: I hop again and land beside you.
I rest on a ledge a while.
I head toward the sound of water.

lines.zh: 我停在岩架上，翅膀收着。
lines.en: I perch on a ledge, wings folded.
I tilt my head at the water below.

lines.zh: 我的翼膜在半明半暗里发亮。
lines.en: My wing membrane glints in the half-light.
I close my eyes slowly and open them.

lines.zh: 我用喙理了理肩上的膜。
lines.en: I groom the membrane at my shoulder with my bill.
I hold still, like a rock.
Something is moving at the far end.
I tuck my head under a wing.
My tail hangs off the ledge.

lines.zh: 我伸开一只翅膀，又收起来。
lines.en: I open one wing and fold it.

lines.zh: 我在等一阵上升的气流。
lines.en: I wait for a rising draft.
My claws hook into a crack.
I stay quiet. No plans to leave.
I glance your way again.

lines.zh: 我低下头，从岩架上看你。
lines.en: I look down at you from the ledge.
You stand below. Perfect.
I hop down and land on the ground.
I come closer, wings half spread.
I tilt my head at your hands.
You have no wings. I am curious.
I arc around your side.

lines.zh: 我伸出一只翅膀，碰了碰你。
lines.en: I extend a wing and touch you.
I pull back and come close again.
I bring my bill to your shoulder.
I have your outline.

lines.zh: 我朝洞顶看了一眼，又看你。
lines.en: I glance at the roof, then at you.

lines.zh: 我在你身边停下，收好翅膀。
lines.en: I stop beside you and fold my wings.
I mean no harm. I only want to look.
I spring away, one wing askew.
I back two steps and fold my wings.
I hit the rock wall.

lines.zh: 我的叫声在洞里闷了一下。
lines.en: My cry muffles against the cave walls.
I stand low, wings spread.

lines.zh: 我把歪掉的翼膜贴回身侧。
lines.en: I fold the bent membrane back to my side.
I spring up to the ledge.
I shake; my plumage is mussed.
I jump again, not as high.
I shrink behind a rock crevice.
That's the smell of a trilocaris tail.
I hop over and land by your hand.
I take it carefully.
I swallow it in a single motion.
Not worth the flight.
I tip my face up, beak still open.
I hop a circle around you.
I rest a claw on your wrist.
Finished, I lick my bill.

lines.zh: 我又靠近一点，翅膀微张。
lines.en: I come closer, wings slightly open.
You raise it; I jump.

lines.zh: 我收起翅膀，踩在你肩头。
lines.en: I fold my wings and perch on your shoulder.

lines.zh: 我拍翅升空，在你头上兜圈。
lines.en: I flap up and circle over your head.
I stop before you and wait.
You bump me; I yield half a step.
I spread my wings to steady myself.

lines.zh: 你踩住我的尾，我抽了抽。
lines.en: You stand on my tail; I tug it loose.

lines.zh: 撞上之后，我借力翻了个身。
lines.en: After the impact I roll with the force.
I go around you. Not angry.

lines.zh: 我落到你旁边，不是撞的。
lines.en: I land beside you. Not by collision.
I back off and fold my wings.
I turn on the spot beside you.
I hop back onto the ledge.

lines.zh: 我低头看被碰到的地方。
lines.en: I look down at where you touched me.
Another glides down from the roof.

lines.zh: 我们并肩站着，翼膜挨着翼膜。
lines.en: We stand shoulder to shoulder, membranes touching.
I bring my bill over.
It grooms my wing membrane.
We fly half a circuit together.

lines.zh: 它落在我旁边的岩缝上。
lines.en: It lands on the crack beside me.
We look at the cavern floor together.
It jumps first; I follow.
We stop at the water's edge.
It sleeps under my wing.
My claws close around it.
I carry it up to the ledge.

lines.zh: 我拨了两下，没什么兴趣。
lines.en: I nudge it twice, not interested.
I peck at it; it isn't food.
I kick it off the ledge.
With it in my bill I cannot climb high.
I carry it into a rock crevice.
It ends up in my claws again.
I circle it once.
My claws slowly open.
I raise my head, beak pointed at you.

lines.zh: 我的翼膜在洞里全部展开。
lines.en: My wing membranes spread wide in the cave.
One push and I land behind your flank.
I am looking for somewhere to land.
I start making loops.

lines.zh: 你所在的岩架我记下了。
lines.en: I have noted the ledge you are on.
I tilt my head and point my beak at you.
I have climbed another stretch.
I fold my wings and drop straight down.

lines.zh: 你每退一步，我就滑一段。
lines.en: Each step you take back, I glide a length.
I circle above your head.

lines.zh: 你一仰头，我就往高处退。
lines.en: The moment you look up, I climb higher.
I ride the current along the stone wall.

lines.zh: 你的箭都从翼膜边上过去了。
lines.en: Your arrows all pass wide of my wings.
I climb a stretch, then hold.

lines.zh: 我无声地停在你后颈那边。
lines.en: I settle silently behind your neck.

lines.zh: 我在半空悬着，等你露头。
lines.en: I hang in the air, waiting for you to show.
You turn; I have already sprung away.
I am measuring the distance.

lines.zh: 我兜回来，从另一侧贴近。
lines.en: I loop back and approach from the other side.
I dive and claw you once.
I knock my bill against your shoulder plate.

lines.zh: 这一下翅膀刮过你的侧脸。
lines.en: My wing rakes across the side of your face.
I hit your chest and bounce away.
The grab does not hold.
I dive in at an angle, wings first.
I land and spring again.

lines.zh: 你挥手的空当，我已经升高。
lines.en: While your hand swings, I am already above.
I return to the ledge.

lines.zh: 我悬在你头顶，扇了两下翅。
lines.en: I hover over your head and beat my wings twice.
I glide down from the roof.

lines.zh: 我落在岩架上，翅膀收好。
lines.en: I land on the ledge and fold my wings.

lines.zh: 我落地前先清了清嗓子。
lines.en: I clear my throat before landing.
The echo in the cavern is loud.
I look toward the water.

lines.zh: 我一落地，岩灰就从翼上抖落。
lines.en: As I land, rock dust shakes off my wings.
I hop down to lower ground.
I work along the wall a way.
I have found a perch.
I begin a slow patrol.

lines.zh: 火燎到翼膜，我拍了两下。
lines.en: Fire catches my membrane; I beat at it.

lines.zh: 我摔在地上，一侧翅膀压坏了。
lines.en: I hit the ground with one wing crushed.
Water closes over me and my legs will not work.
I'm thrown into a pile of rubble.
An arrow passes through my membrane.
That light stuns my sight.
Too hungry to jump.

lines.zh: 雷打在岩顶上，我摔下来。
lines.en: Lightning hits the roof; I fall.

lines.zh: 黑暗里没有气流，我往下掉。
lines.en: No drafts in the dark. I fall.
